title: Concept: OS command execution via popen (cpp) — review required
description: In cpp, popen executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (fork plus exec with an argument vector) are cpp-specific.
applicability: cpp codebases that launch external processes through popen; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
